title: Lucky Clover Rally
description: A Garketing arcade 3D racer: drift, boost and jump through a giant sunlit canyon. Equal cars, lucky clover boxes, mega ramps, banked turns, split-screen and a Track Lab. Random tools. Real results. Lucky you.

defaultCaptions.x: Charged drifts, lucky clover boxes and mega ramps through a giant sunlit canyon. Every car is equal — only your line matters. Play Lucky Clover Rally by Garketing in your browser. Lucky you.
defaultCaptions.facebook: Lucky Clover Rally by Garketing is a fast arcade 3D racer: three laps, 16 gates a lap, equal cars and pure skill. Race AI rivals or a friend in split-screen. Random tools. Real results. Lucky you.
